verdict.rationale: Plain-language founder guidance is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two robots.txt probes that returned HTTP 403 (mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in). It contains no content showing step-by-step explainers or non-lawyer guidance for founder tasks. The access walls neither show nor rule out such guidance, so the verdict rests on absence of evidence and confidence is low.
